description: Puerto Rico government contracts of $100,000 or more on file with the Comptroller's contract registry (Oficina del Contralor, Registro de Contratos), from 787daily's Contract Watch tracker, read weekly: the fiscal year so far (July to June) against a year earlier, every fiscal year since 2017, the year's largest agencies and contractors (private firms and organizations; the top ten's share), the fund split (federal, state, the agency's own revenue, combined), service groups, the contracts newly on file this week and the largest amendments to contracts of $1 million or more. `agency` gives one agency's largest contracts (e.g. 'PREPA', 'AAA'); `contractor` one contractor's. Every amount is the contract's whole value over its term, as filed: never characterize a contract. Cite 787daily.com/contracts/ and the Comptroller's registry.

agency.description: An agency by its short or full name, e.g. 'PREPA', 'AAA' or 'Departamento de Educación'

contractor.description: A contractor's name as filed, e.g. 'Ciro Bess, LLC'

name: get_government_contracts
title: Puerto Rico government contracts
